warning.titlePre: Mercedes CLC 200 Timing Chain & Balance Shaft Wear
paragraphs: CLC 200 engines — M271, across every generation — commonly show timing chain stretch and balance shaft issues over time. We replace timing chain components, timing gears, and gaskets as standard on every M271 rebuild.

*include_in_hero_hook: yes — Source: established Mercedes specialist pattern (per VRF-mercedes-clc-class.md). The diesel OM646 is not covered by this claim as it was not independently confirmed for this application.*
